title: FIELD_VALUES search requests must drop untyped fields (labels, updated_by)
answers: Library panel search box / folder search by title returns 500 'unknown response field "labels"'
Searching folders or dashboards fails only when a search term is entered, browsing works fine
Which fields can I request on a ResourceSearchRequest with ResultFormat FIELD_VALUES?
Why does my search request work with RESOURCE_TABLE but fail with FIELD_VALUES?
body:
Symptom: searching library panels/folders by title fails with 500 'unknown response field "labels"'; browsing (empty query) still works because folder resolution only runs when the search string is non-empty.
Root cause: pkg/services/folder/folderimpl/folder_unifiedstorage.go:SearchFolders set ResultFormat to FIELD_VALUES but requested dashboardsearch.IncludeFields, which contains bare 'labels' and 'updated_by' — fields with no typed FIELD_VALUES definition. The table format silently drops unknown fields; FIELD_VALUES rejects them.
Fix pattern: maintain a reduced field list (dashboardsearch.FieldValueIncludeFields in pkg/services/dashboards/service/search/search.go, derived from IncludeFields minus tableOnlyFields) and use it for any request whose ResultFormat is FIELD_VALUES. Per-label fields like 'labels.<key>' are typed and must stay.
Constraints: only applies to FIELD_VALUES requests; RESOURCE_TABLE requests may keep the full IncludeFields list. When adding a new field to IncludeFields, decide whether it needs a typed field-value definition or belongs in tableOnlyFields.
applies: Any code in pkg/services/dashboards or pkg/services/folder that builds a resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest with ResultFormat FIELD_VALUES.
says: Searching folders or dashboards by title fails with unknown field error
Library panel search works when browsing but fails with any search text
Folder search by title returns an error only when entering a search term
Searching panels and dashboards triggers a field error in the search box
search: FIELD_VALUES search requests must exclude bare untyped fields (labels, updated_by) that lack a typed FIELD_VALUES definition; RESOURCE_TABLE silently drops unknown fields but FIELD_VALUES rejects them with 500 errors. Use a reduced field list like dashboardsearch.FieldValueIncludeFields derived from IncludeFields minus tableOnlyFields; per-label fields like labels.<key> are typed and must stay. This constraint applies only to ResourceSearchRequest with ResultFormat=FIELD_VALUES in pkg/services/dashboards/service/search/search.go and pkg/services/folder/folderimpl/folder_unifiedstorage.go:SearchFolders. When adding new fields to IncludeFields, decide whether they need a typed field-value definition or belong in tableOnlyFields.
